purpose: Collapse the accumulated Mandala research into one adjudication snapshot, explicitly separating measured results from unresolved topology so G4 is not opened prematurely.

outer72.basis: 5-degree periodic family detected in SRC-0002 and independently present in SRC-0003; cross-source confirmation remains heterogeneous at individual boundaries.

outerConditionalAddressSpace.meaning: 4 candidate radial bands x 72 candidate sectors; address space only, not canonical cell count.

H22.reason: Independent 3/7/12 periodic families occur at distinct radial scales, but 22 independently bounded planar faces have not been demonstrated.

H441.reason: No measured topology currently yields or independently supports 441 atomic fields; target fitting is forbidden.

cardinalityBounds.warning: 60, 128 and 22 are evidence-class/cardinality summaries, not quantities that may be arithmetically combined into a canonical AK total.

finalBlockingProblem.name: planar face reconstruction + cross-source field refinement
finalBlockingProblem.central: Trace actual rose walls, collapse double edges, mask internal symbol strokes, build planar graph and enumerate bounded faces without 22 as a target.
finalBlockingProblem.outer: Refine the 288 conditional fields with cross-source boundary continuity; preserve source-specific and unresolved fields.
finalBlockingProblem.whyBlocking: Atomic identity requires reproducible fields/faces, not periodicity or heuristic scores alone.

g4.reason: Final canonical field cardinality and frozen topology are not yet established.

decision: Stop micro-gating. The next executable research operation must batch the remaining central planar-face reconstruction and outer cross-source refinement, then emit one topology-freeze candidate and one final hypothesis adjudication.
